invariants.rationale: The method uses 'element' extensively without checks after initial assignment; it must not be null at exit.
The method only performs actions if element.getName() is 'tileset', so it's likely still true at method exit within this guarded block.
The method calls getRelativeFileHandle and other operations with tmxFile, which must therefore be non-null.
The method passes imageResolver to addStaticTiles, which requires it to be non-null.
The method retrieves tileElements via element.getChildrenByName("tile"), assuming this will not return null.
